headline.title: Mapping Europe’s AI Workforce Opportunity
headline.summary: A recent OpenAI report analyzes the potential impact of AI on the European workforce, identifying occupations at risk of automation, those expected to grow, and areas where workflow changes may occur. The findings aim to inform policymakers and businesses about the evolving job landscape in the EU.

articles.title: Open Models, Closed Environments: Palantir Brings Secure AI to US Agencies With NVIDIA Nemotron
articles.summary: Palantir has launched a new intelligent engine that utilizes NVIDIA Nemotron open models to enhance secure AI capabilities for U.S. government agencies. This initiative underscores the significance of open source innovation in maintaining American technology leadership.

articles.title: This Humanoid Robot Is a Terrifyingly Competent Office Intern
articles.summary: Flexion Robotics, a startup founded by former Nvidia engineers, has developed a humanoid robot designed to perform office tasks efficiently. The company employs innovative training methods to enhance the robot's capabilities in a work environment.

articles.title: HP Inc. launches Frontier strategic partnership with OpenAI
articles.summary: HP Inc. has expanded its strategic partnership with OpenAI to enhance AI integration in customer experiences, software development, and enterprise operations. This collaboration aims to leverage advanced AI technologies to improve efficiency and innovation within HP's offerings.

articles.title: MER-R1: Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Slow-Fast Thinking Synergy
articles.summary: The study titled "MER-R1: Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Slow-Fast Thinking Synergy" reveals that explicit reasoning does not always enhance multimodal emotion recognition accuracy, despite improving interpretability. The findings indicate that fast thinking, which provides direct answers, often yields better performance than slow, deliberative reasoning in emotion recognition tasks.

articles.title: JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC) V1: An Industrial-Scale LLM/VLM-Centric Solution for Item Understanding, Management, and Applications
articles.summary: JD.com has introduced the JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC) V1, a large language model and vision model-centric solution designed to enhance item understanding, management, and applications for its extensive e-commerce platform. This initiative aims to address challenges related to rapidly evolving concepts and the need for high-quality structured item knowledge to improve consumer experiences and operational efficiency.

articles.title: Not All Relations Rotate Alike: Transformation-Aware Decoupling for Viewpoint-Robust 3D Scene Graph Generation
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach to 3D Scene Graph Generation (3DSGG) that addresses the limitations of existing models in producing consistent relational predictions when viewing scenes from different yaw rotations. The proposed method, termed transformation-aware decoupling, aims to enhance viewpoint robustness in the generation of structured object-relation-object graphs for improved spatial understanding in embodied intelligence applications.

articles.title: CoIn: Comprehensive 2D-3D Inpainting with Gaussian Splatting Guidance
articles.summary: The article introduces CoIn, a new framework that integrates 2D inpainting models with 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS) to enhance 3D scene reconstruction by addressing occlusions and viewpoint limitations. CoIn utilizes a multi-stage consistency pipeline, improving upon existing methods that rely heavily on precise segmentation masks and are limited to object removal tasks.

articles.title: KG2Cypher: Data-Centric Pipeline for Building Enterprise Text-to-Cypher Systems
articles.summary: KG2Cypher is a new data-centric pipeline designed to create text-to-Cypher systems for enterprise knowledge graphs, streamlining the process of building natural-language interfaces. The system constructs executable Cypher queries from existing graph data and utilizes large language models to generate corresponding natural-language queries.

articles.title: S$^2$-VLA: State-Space Guided Vision-Language-Action Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
articles.summary: The article introduces S$^2$-VLA, a new model designed to enhance Vision-Language-Action (VLA) capabilities in long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks by utilizing state-space guidance to improve feature fusion. This approach aims to reduce cumulative error propagation and allows for adaptive integration of visual, language, and action representations throughout different phases of task execution.

articles.title: Reflect-R1: Evidence-Driven Reflection for Self-Correction in Long Video Understanding
articles.summary: The article presents Reflect-R1, a new approach for long video understanding that utilizes evidence-driven reflection to enhance self-correction in multimodal models. By addressing the limitations of existing closed-loop reflection mechanisms and reducing policy coupling in reinforcement learning, Reflect-R1 aims to improve error correction in video analysis.

articles.title: Home3D 1.0: A High-Fidelity Image-to-3D Asset Generation System for Interior Design
articles.summary: Home3D 1.0 is a modular image-to-3D generation system designed to create high-quality 3D assets for interior design and e-commerce from a single reference image. The system outputs a mesh with physically-based rendering materials, which can be decomposed into material-specific components, organized into four interconnected modules.
